SOA SPENDING UP DESPITE UNCLEAR BENEFITS

The number of companies investing in service-oriented architecture (SOA)
has doubled over the past year in every part of the world, with a
typical annual spend of nearly $1.4 million, according to a new research
report from the analyst firm AMR Research that surveyed 405 companies
in the U.S., Germany, and China.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/25/news-soa-adoption_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-26

NETWORK SOLUTIONS SUED OVER DOMAIN NAME POLICY

A class-action lawsuit filed on Monday against Network Solutions alleges
the company has unfairly profited from its domain name registration
business.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/26/Network-Solutions-sued-over-domain-name-policy_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-26

IBM LAUNCHES Z10 MAINFRAME

IBM Tuesday is set to launch the System z10, its next-generation
mainframe, featuring quad-core processors and aimed at
computing-intensive tasks.

BLACKBERRY STUMBLES OVER WORDS IN TAIWAN

BlackBerry sales in Taiwan in 2007 disappointed the local vendor of the
popular devices, but the company expects a big improvement this year
because people on the island will be able to type mobile e-mails in
their own language.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/26/BlackBerry-stumbles-over-words-in-Taiwan_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-26

GOOGLE PART OF GROUP BUILDING CABLE TO JAPAN

Google is one of six companies in a new consortium called Unity that is
building a new undersea cable to boost Internet capacity between the
United States and Asia.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/26/Google-part-of-group-building-cable-to-Japan_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-26

U.S. JUDGE POKES HOLE IN FILE-SHARING LAWSUIT

Legal experts say a recent U.S. court ruling could force the music
industry to provide more evidence against people accused of illegal file
sharing.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/26/US-judge-pokes-hole-in-file-sharing-lawsuit_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-26

INDIA'S WIPRO PLANS BIG EXPANSION IN CHINA

Indian IT outsourcing company Wipro plans a big expansion in China in
the next two years, its chief operating officer said in Tokyo on
Tuesday.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/26/Wipro-plans-big-expansion-in-China_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-26

YOUTUBE OUTAGE UNDERSCORES BIG INTERNET PROBLEM

Sunday's inadvertent disruption of Google's YouTube video service
underscores a flaw in the Internet's design that could some day lead to
a serious security problem, according to networking experts.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/26/YouTube-outage-underscores-big-Internet-problem_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-26
